sole_research_target_acknowledgement: My sole research target in this invocation is the full quadratic-form bounded-density statement for arbitrary independent one-dimensional densities bounded by 1 and every symmetric matrix with at least three eigenvalues of modulus at least 1.

latest_substantive_result.scope: A four-coordinate one-exception block epsilon*lambda*I+s vv^T remains uniformly density-bounded under every symmetric operator-norm perturbation <=delta*lambda for all delta<1/5, with explicit C_delta/lambda; any arbitrary matrix completion outside that certified principal block is harmless by conditioning. Full target remains open.

first_unresolved_implication: Prove a universal aggregate/diffuse versus local-block dichotomy from only the hypothesis of three arbitrary large eigenvalues; fixed-size principal-block extraction is false for delocalized rank-three projectors.
next_concrete_attempt: Combine the new delta<1/5 local stability basin with source-valid cross-block/partition estimates to seek a quantitative dichotomy that covers concentrated and delocalized three-eigendirection geometries.
